valid_run_status: completed; corrected pair used eval=True and verified 272 training / 39 development cameras
verdict: The corrected p=0.75 pair showed small mixed 10K metric changes, with descriptive paired intervals crossing zero. It did not establish higher novel-view quality or algorithmic speedup; do not advance this Python-mask candidate.

initial_invalid_attempt.status: audit-only; not used for quality conclusions
initial_invalid_attempt.reason: The first launcher omitted --eval, so eval=False put all 311 room cameras, including the 39 measured views, in training.

split.verified_by: Both output cfg_args record eval=True; author readColmapSceneInfo splits idx%8==0 into 39 held-out views; evaluator asserted 272 train and 39 development cameras.

protocol.loss: 0.8 * L1 + 0.2 * (1 - fused_ssim), computed at full resolution on every forward
protocol.mask: Each 16x16 tile omits one random checkerboard parity class, retaining 75% of pixels and scaling retained image VJP entries by 4/3.
protocol.mask_generator: Independent CUDA torch.Generator seeded 20260927; p=1 control registers no image-gradient hook.

matched_author_settings.camera_rng: Author safe_state and camera-selection path remained unchanged; both fresh processes started from the same checkpoint and configuration except output path and mask probability.

paired_development_evaluation.limits: Single scene and one paired run; views are correlated and previously consulted. All paired t intervals cross zero and are descriptive, not independent-view or generalization evidence. PSNR/SSIM means rose slightly while LPIPS worsened.

timing_interpretation: p75 was 0.39 s (0.3%) faster by complete process wall and 0.0043 s faster by author internal training time in this single run. The mask does not skip CUDA raster backward work, so these timings do not establish algorithmic speedup.
checkpoint_timing_note: The author's scene.save(10000) writes the PLY before the final-iteration densification event. The added Adam checkpoint is written at process end, after that event.
